class.name: OcgShapeextendBasicmsgregistrator
class.brief_description: Abstract class that can be used for attaching messages to the objects (e.g. shapes). It is used by ShapeHealing algorithms to attach a message describing encountered case (e.g. removing small edge from a wire).
class.description: ! Abstract class that can be used for attaching messages ! to the objects (e.g. shapes). ! It is used by ShapeHealing algorithms to attach a message ! describing encountered case (e.g. removing small edge from ! a wire). ! ! The methods of this class are empty and redefined, for instance, ! in the classes for Data Exchange processors for attaching ! messages to interface file entities or CAS.CADE shapes.
